svg.title: An image as a grid of numbers
svg.desc: Left: an 8 by 8 pixel greyscale image of a handwritten seven. Right: the same image as the grid of brightness numbers the computer receives, 0 for black up to 255 for white.
svg.text: What people see, and what the computer receives
0 = black, 255 = white. A colour pixel has three such numbers: red, green and blue.
A 12-megapixel colour photo holds about 36 million numbers.
